subject: amazon-q-developer-cli
title: Next-gen agent framework returns unconditional Allow for ExecuteCmd/Introspect/SpawnSubagent (pre-ship landmine)
one_why: evaluate_tool_permission short-circuits command execution to Allow before any settings check; unreachable today (agent crate main is a stub, crates/agent/src/main.rs:1-21; chat-cli imports types only, agent/rts/mod.rs:12-14) so shipped-behavior scoring leaves safety at 6, but the hole activates the day the framework is wired - the correct fix pattern is per-tool settings lookup with fail-to-Ask, not a built-in branch that hard-codes Allow.

subject: amazon-q-developer-cli
title: Ls and ImageRead validated against fs_write path lists while comment claims fs_read
one_why: A user denying reads under settings.fs_read.denied_paths gets no protection from ls/image_read in this framework - read tools consult fs_write allowed/denied lists; the stale comment 'Reuse the same settings for fs read' above the fs_write call shows policy-model drift, and read-tool permission must be governed by read-path lists or the deny layer is trivially bypassed once the framework ships.

subject: amazon-q-developer-cli
title: Push-gated test job excludes a crate absent from the workspace (rename-rot from Fig era)
one_why: Boundary ruling: cargo warns-and-continues on an unmatched --exclude under --workspace, so the job still tests all 10 real crates - trivia, not a verification demotion; but stale selection flags are how silent test-loss eventually enters a workflow, and the dead fig_desktop-fuzz name will confuse the next maintainer editing the gate.

subject: amazon-q-developer-cli
title: cargo-llvm-cov installed in test job but plain cargo test runs - coverage collected never
one_why: The CI pays the nightly-toolchain + install-action cost for coverage tooling and then invokes plain cargo test, so no coverage number is ever produced or gated - instrumentation as decoration, sixth variant of the instrumented-but-unenforced family (forge, jazz, deepagents).

subject: amazon-q-developer-cli
title: Terminal-bench eval harness wired only to workflow_dispatch - never blocks a merge
one_why: A real benchmark integration (tb run against terminal-bench-core, with OIDC + artifact upload) exists but can only be started by hand from the Actions UI - benchmark capability that never gates pushes is verification theater adjacent; the ledger's 9-grade gate (prime-agent behavioral-evals.yml:430) shows the label-gated blocking shape this lacks.

subject: amazon-q-developer-cli
title: 203,219 of ~280k repo LOC are smithy-generated clients - zero architecture credit, zero god-file blame
one_why: Every file in the five amzn-* crates carries 'Code generated by software.amazon.smithy.rust.codegen.smithy-rs. DO NOT EDIT'; hand-written mass is 77,127 LOC (chat-cli 53,309 / agent 13,051 / semantic-search 9,142) with ~11.8k inline test LOC - scoring this subject's architecture or verification off census totals would inflate it ~3.6x; fourth formal use of the generated/vendored zero-credit rule after deepagents fixtures, auto-code-rover blobs, memcode vendored fork.
